title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: invoke the Researcher agent through the Work IQ API
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents loss of service access when spending limits are reached, contrary to the briefing's claim that this is not documented. The page also unnecessarily casts doubt on the published Work IQ API billing rule and omits a required qualification when changing a policy to pay-as-you-go.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Cost management reaches the place that governs Work IQ API access and spending.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft admin center, Copilot > Cost management, admins can monitor Copilot Credit consumption and manage spending associated with ... Work IQ API.
claims.fix: Complete the existing-policy route as 'Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration > spending policy > Spending limits'. Use https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/usage-based-billing-manage-copilot-credits#edit-spending-policy for the control's last steps and add it to sources.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id} updates an existing spending policy's periodLimit, perUserLimit or billingMethods.
claims.quote: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/3f9e2c1a-0000-0000-0000-00000000c21b ... The following properties can be updated: `displayName`, `periodLimit`, `perUserLimit`, and `billingMethods`.

claims.claim: The spending policy update operation is beta.
claims.quote: APIs under the `/beta` version are subject to change. ... Delegated (work or school account) | CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All ... Application | Not supported.

claims.claim: The spending policy update requires an If-Match header carrying the policy ETag.
claims.quote: `If-Match` | The ETag of the spending policy. Required.

claims.claim: The description of changing billingMethods omits the required billingInstrument when changing stored non-pay-as-you-go funding to include pay-as-you-go.
claims.quote: When `billingMethods` changes stored funding from non-pay-as-you-go to a value that includes `payAsYouGo` ... also supply a billingInstrument with all three writable coordinates: `billingSubscriptionId`, `billingResourceGroup`, and `billingRegion`.
claims.fix: Append to controls[0].note: 'When changing stored non-pay-as-you-go funding to include payAsYouGo, also supply a complete billingInstrument with billingSubscriptionId, billingResourceGroup and billingRegion; use a supported billing-geography key for billingRegion.'
